reveal_en: Forests are not just collections of individual trees. Below ground, trees are connected by a vast "Wood Wide Web" of mycorrhizal fungi, through which they exchange nutrients, water, and even warning signals.
reveal_zh: 森林并非只是独立的树木集合。在地下，树木通过庞大的真菌网络“林中万维网”彼此相连，交换养分、水分，甚至传递警报信号。
meaning_en: This hidden network reveals a profound, cooperative intelligence in nature, reshaping our understanding of ecosystems as deeply integrated communities.
meaning_zh: 这个隐藏的网络揭示了自然界深刻的合作智慧，重塑了我们对生态系统作为紧密社区的理解。

visual.motion: Roots and mycelium slowly intertwining and subtly glowing.
